integrity: The kernel weights, absolute kernel mass and Dobrushin-type coefficient reduction are prior knowledge; the asserted contribution is the exact finite-cycle saturation set, gap and arithmetic zero-weight cases. No independent audit or mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Equal-weight quadratic/cubic center smoothing, real cyclic nonaliasing grids only; finite intermediate norm formula, no nonperiodic, weighted or higher-degree extensions. Historical priority provisional because an overshoot-related 1983 paper was not available in full.
title: Resonant saturation and missing dimensions for cyclic Savitzky–Golay variation gain
